Inspect, plan, copy, and verify local RAW disks

Usage: rvddk [OPTIONS] <COMMAND>

Commands:
  inspect  Inspect a regular RAW file
  plan     Preview logical work and destination policy; does not create or write output
  copy     Copy RAW bytes; publish new output without replacement
  verify   Compare source bytes with the destination prefix; no writes
  help     Print this message or the help of the given subcommand(s)

Options:
      --json     Emit schema-versioned JSON; errors go to stderr
  -h, --help     Print help
  -V, --version  Print version

Inspect a regular RAW file

Usage: rvddk inspect [OPTIONS] --format <format> <source>

Arguments:
  <source>  

Options:
      --format <format>                Explicit input format; no format autodetection [possible values: raw]
      --json                           Emit schema-versioned JSON; errors go to stderr
      --memory-budget <memory-budget>  Planning/execution payload budget in bytes; not an RSS limit [default: 268435456]
      --extents                        Include the complete logical extent map
  -h, --help                           Print help

Preview logical work and destination policy; does not create or write output

Usage: rvddk plan [OPTIONS] --format <format> <source> <destination>

Arguments:
  <source>       
  <destination>  

Options:
      --format <format>                Explicit input format; no format autodetection [possible values: raw]
      --json                           Emit schema-versioned JSON; errors go to stderr
      --memory-budget <memory-budget>  Planning/execution payload budget in bytes; not an RSS limit [default: 268435456]
      --block-size <block-size>        Copy/comparison block size in bytes [default: 1048576]
      --overwrite                      Preview in-place overwrite of an existing file; still performs no writes
      --backend <backend>              Requested copy backend; native selection is deferred until destination preparation [default: threaded] [possible values: threaded, auto, io-uring]
      --workers <workers>              Threaded worker count [default: 1]
      --queue-depth <queue-depth>      Requested native queue depth [default: 8]
      --extents                        Include the complete logical extent map
  -h, --help                           Print help

Copy RAW bytes; publish new output without replacement

Usage: rvddk copy [OPTIONS] --format <format> <source> <destination>

Arguments:
  <source>       
  <destination>  

Options:
      --format <format>                Explicit input format; no format autodetection [possible values: raw]
      --json                           Emit schema-versioned JSON; errors go to stderr
      --memory-budget <memory-budget>  Planning/execution payload budget in bytes; not an RSS limit [default: 268435456]
      --block-size <block-size>        Copy/comparison block size in bytes [default: 1048576]
      --overwrite                      Modify an existing destination in place; failures may leave partial changes
      --backend <backend>              Execution backend; Auto can fall back before mutation [default: threaded] [possible values: threaded, auto, io-uring]
      --workers <workers>              Threaded worker count [default: 1]
      --queue-depth <queue-depth>      Requested native queue depth [default: 8]
      --verify                         Read back and compare all logical bytes before publishing new output
  -h, --help                           Print help

Compare source bytes with the destination prefix; no writes

Usage: rvddk verify [OPTIONS] --format <format> <source> <destination>

Arguments:
  <source>       
  <destination>  

Options:
      --format <format>                Explicit input format; no format autodetection [possible values: raw]
      --json                           Emit schema-versioned JSON; errors go to stderr
      --memory-budget <memory-budget>  Planning/execution payload budget in bytes; not an RSS limit [default: 268435456]
      --block-size <block-size>        Copy/comparison block size in bytes [default: 1048576]
  -h, --help                           Print help
